unfold.unfolded: Let $G$ be a connected reductive group, $T$ a maximal torus of $G$, and $\lambda$ a weight. Let $t\in T$ be an element of order $2$. Let $Y_t$ be the set of $v\in W^P$ with $B^t\cdot vP/P=vP/P$, let $d_v$ be the integer attached to $v\in Y_t$, and let $d:=\max_{v\in Y_t}\{d_v\}$. Let $\chi^t_\lambda(n)$ be the function of $n$ defined in the paper, which is the character $n\mapsto \Theta_{n\lambda}(t^{-1})$. Then the restriction of $\chi^t_\lambda$ to the set of even nonnegative integers $\{n\in 2\mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}\}$ is a polynomial function in $n$ of degree exactly equal to $d$.
